lessons.title: Ordering Food

items.exampleMeaning: How much does a sandwich cost?

lessons.tip: Use 'por favor' when you ask for something. It's polite and appreciated. Remember to say 'obrigado' or 'obrigada' after receiving help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O que você gostaria de pedir?
dialogue.meaning: What would you like to order?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu gostaria de um café, por favor.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How much does the sandwich cost?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não sei. Você pode me ajudar?
dialogue.meaning: I don’t know. Can you help me?

scenario.brief: You are at a café. Ask for a coffee and a sandwich. Ask how much the sandwich costs.
scenario.goal: You need to order food and drink politely.

lessons.title: Asking for the Bill

items.example: Eu quero mais um café, por favor.
items.exampleMeaning: I want one more coffee, please.

items.example: Sim, claro, eu trago a conta.
items.exampleMeaning: Yes, of course, I will bring the bill.

lessons.tip: When asking for the bill, say 'a conta'. If you need more time, you can say 'um momento'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você precisa de mais alguma coisa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, claro. A conta, por favor.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course. The bill, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Um momento, eu trago a conta.
dialogue.meaning: One moment, I will bring the bill.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Desculpe, eu não entendi o preço.
dialogue.meaning: Sorry, I didn’t understand the price.

scenario.brief: You finished your meal. Ask for the bill politely and clarify the price if needed.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for the bill and thank the employee.

lessons.title: Counting to Twenty

items.exampleMeaning: I want four glasses of water.

lessons.tip: Practice counting from one to twenty. It helps when ordering food and drinks.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How many coffees do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu quero um café, por favor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want four glasses of water.

scenario.brief: You are ordering drinks and food. Use numbers to specify how many you want.
scenario.goal: You need to order the correct number of items.

lessons.title: Polite Conversations

items.example: Com licença, onde está o banheiro?
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?

lessons.tip: Use 'com licença' to get someone's attention politely. If you need clarification, say 'pode repetir?'

scenario.brief: You are having a conversation with the café employee. Ask for help and clarify if needed.
scenario.goal: You need to communicate politely and clearly.
